chunking: fixed-size character windows within each page (fixed_size)
metadata: document_id, source, page, pages, chapter, article (taken at window start)
hypothesis: Baseline: short uniform windows give precise top-1 matches for short factual questions but cut sentences and mislabel article/chapter when a window crosses a heading
notes: 235 chunks; selected on dev (tie with C on Hit@3, wins on Hit@1). Evidence split across chunks: d12, t04. Draft audit: coherence 0.7/2, metadata 13/15, grounding 0.8/2. First run used 500/50 but 98/173 chunks exceeded the model's 128-token limit; resized before any test run.

chunking: structure-aware: paragraphs grouped within one Điều, never crossing an article; long sentences split at . ; :, hard cut if still too long (by_paragraph)
metadata: document_id, source, page, pages (multi-page paragraphs joined), chapter, article (exact per chunk)
hypothesis: Changing chunking (also overlap 36→0 and article/chapter assignment, so not a single-factor change): chunks that respect Điều boundaries are more coherent and carry correct article/chapter, improving Hit@3 on questions whose evidence is a whole clause
notes: 275 chunks, 34 span two pages. Evidence split: d08. Draft audit: coherence 1.3/2, metadata 15/15, grounding 0.8/2. Low Hit@1: correct chunk often ranked 2-3 (not yet diagnosed). Long legal sentences force hard cuts at 360 chars.

filter: chapter = value supplied with the question (only for questions that carry a filter: d10, d15, t04)
hypothesis: Changing only the filter: restricting to the user-supplied chapter removes near-duplicate content from other chapters (hóa đơn Ch.II vs chứng từ Ch.III)
notes: Filter compliance dev 2/2, test 1/1 (A 0/2, 0/1; B 1/2, 0/1). d15 and t04: miss in B, top-1 in C. Same as B on questions without filter.
